en:
*hic!* This is an official announcement...
from the Ultimate Academy... *hic!*

As you can see, Monokid has had a little too
much honey.

He was really, really happy about Daddy's
return.

*hic!* Now let's play darts! Monodam can
be the dartboard!

And let's go bowling...Monodam can be
the ball!

By the way...which announcement were
we making?
...The nighttime announcement.

What, it's already that late?
Then we should go to bed soon!
Zzzzzzzzzzz...
Bedtime, ursine!
It's already nighttime...

At this rate, the time limit will expire before
we know it...
<CLT=cltMIND>But I won't lose... I won't give up.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because I want to see everyone's smiles
just a little longer...

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to spend time with them, laughing
and talking like normal teenagers.
<CLT=cltMIND>So...I won't give up.
I'll teach you guys how to win over a lady.

First, you gotta give her a present.
Ladies can't resist presents.

But you can't give her any present. It's
gotta be a present suited to her tastes.

And it's gotta be a handmade present, too.
So it looks like you put thought into it.

For example, the kinda lady who's into
strong men would love a handmade...
pro wrestling group.

She'll love bein' surrounded by macho dudes,
and you'll make money off the wrestlers, too!

If enough wrestlers get popular, then it
might be good to host a big event.

And after they're done beating up each other,
they can fight other pro wrestling groups!

Just give it a shot, and I'm positive you'll
win her heart!
Rise and shine, ursine!
Zzzzzzz...

This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy.

It's 8 a.m.! Time to wake up! Let's have a
wonderful killing school semester today!
Zzzzzzz...

Geez, Monokid really drank too much honey...
How long is he gonna keep sleeping?

Oh, by the way...Father's time limit expires
at <CLT=cltSTRONG>10 p.m. tomorrow night<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
So long! Bear-well!
<CLT=cltMIND>The time limit ends tomorrow night...

<CLT=cltMIND>Shuichi is gambling on that, which means we have
to watch the library while time is running out.

<CLT=cltMIND>Shouldn't we start preparing then?
I'm getting worried...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong*
Oh, Shuichi? Perfect timing...

I saw Miu heading to the dining hall.
I think she'll still be there...

Kaede...
I'm sorry...for asking you to do this.

Don't worry about it.
I promised I would help you out.
Come on, let's head to the dining hall.
<CLT=cltMIND>It's probably Shuichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>Geez, how annoying!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Shuichi! I wanted to ask you somethi—
<CLT=cltMIND>But as soon as I answered the door...
Too bad! It's me!
Aaaaaaaaahhhhh!!!!!

Hmph... It hurts my heart to be screamed
at by a young girl.
...But it hurts so good all the same.
Wh-What do you want?

Ahh, I figured I'd come let you know that
some of the research labs are open.

You mean the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Labs<CLT=cltNORMAL>? Those
classrooms tailored to our 16 talents...?

Uh-huh. Your lab is finally all set up, so you can
go in whenever you want.

Now, go to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist's Lab<CLT=cltNORMAL>
right away and compose a murderous melody!

A murderous melody?
What are you even talking about?

So, um...are you gonna invite me inside for
tea or what?
No, of course not!

<CLT=cltMIND>I slammed the door in Monokuma's face
with all my might.
Geez...that was super annoying...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong*
God! How annoying!

Geez, enough already!
You're bothering me!
Ah, I'm sorry! Should I come back later?
Oh, Shuichi! Sorry, just ignore what I said!

I wanted to talk to you too, Shuichi... I was
wondering if we needed anything for the plan.

That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
I might know how to keep watch on the library.

Weren't we planning on hiding inside the
library and keeping watch from there?

If we did that, we risk the mastermind running
into us. It's safer to watch from further away.

We also need hard evidence to convince
everyone of the mastermind's identity...

So that's why...I thought it might
be a good idea to set up cameras.
Cameras?

I found some cameras and
security sensors in the warehouse.

With some modification,
we could combine the two...

...and have cameras that will <CLT=cltSTRONG>detect movement
and take pictures<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If we set up a few in the library,
we can capture proof of the mastermind.

And we don't have to be in the library for this
to work, so we are less likely to get caught.

Th-That's a really good idea...
But do you know how to modify a camera?
Ah, well...I don't know how...

That's why...I wanted to ask Miu.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltNORMAL> could help us...
Oh, yeah. That's true.

But, she's...pretty intimidating, so I'm
having trouble talking to her by myself.
Oh! In that case, we should ask her together!

I saw Miu heading to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>dining hall<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I think she'll still be there...

Ah, but, we should be careful about what we
tell her... She might be..."<CLT=cltSTRONG>it<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
<CLT=cltMIND>She might be "it"...?

<CLT=cltMIND>As in...Miu might be the mastermind?
Hm, I doubt it, but...
Well, if that's what you think...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
